title: Assignment
text: Assign values to specified elements of signal, 3 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Interval between samples; {Number of output dimensions} sets the number of dimensions of the output signal, {Index mode}, {Index Option} sets the index method for elements, {Index}, {Output Size} sets the width of block output signal, {Initialize output (Y)} sets how to initialize output signal Initialize using input port, {Action if any output element is not assigned} sets the option to produce warning and {Check for out-of-range index in accelerated simulation} sets the option to check for out-of-range index values in accelerator and rapid accelerator simulation. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Y0
ports.summary: Initial value of output signal scalar | vector

ports.name: IndxN
ports.summary: N th index signal scalar | vector

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: Output signal with assigned values scalar | vector

params.name: Number of output dimensions
params.values: Number of dimensions of the output signal 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Index Option
params.values: Index method for elements Index vector (dialog) (default) | Assign all | Index vector (port) | Starting index (dialog) | Starting index (port)

params.name: Output Size
params.values: Width of block output signal 1 (default) | integer

params.name: Initialize output (Y)
params.values: How to initialize output signal Initialize using input port <Y0> (default) | Specify size for each dimension in the table

params.name: Action if any output element is not assigned
params.values: Option to produce warning or error Warning (default) | Error | None

params.name: Check for out-of-range index in accelerated simulation
params.values: Option to check for out-of-range index values in accelerator and rapid accelerator simulation modes off (default) | on
